rows.grounds: fused ca + uktām; accusative feminine singular past participle
compound svasti + sūkta; accusative neuter singular
accusative neuter singular adjective or noun

items.question: What recitation and auspicious element follow the preparations already described?
premises: The said svasti-sūkta is to be recited.
Both are accusative objects of ritual action.
items.inference: The verse prescribes reciting the svasti-sūkta together with an auspicious rite.
uncertainties: The exact ritual action and the precise referent of maṅgalam are not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: And the said svasti-sūkta and auspicious [rite] (are to be used).
